scope: Read-only hardware telemetry over covered intervals only. Missing intervals remain unknown. Process inventory refreshes at most once per minute and can lag launches/exits. Busy percentage uses all 64 logical cores, including idle cores; it is not FLOP efficiency. Observed process occupancy is distinct from assigned experiment chip-hours and the whole-node invoice. The source file stops emitting counters when no NRT process reports a valid period. Counter absence is not filled with zero.

owned_native_reservations_in_same_window.scope: Only the recorded owned native stages, clipped to the same clock window. Starts are derived from recorded end UTC and monotonic wall seconds; end UTC is rounded to seconds. This is reservation scheduling, not hardware busy percentage, a monetary invoice, or an assumption about unobserved hardware intervals.
